parallel.requirements: Parallel recognized the CLI/output parity requirement and ESM file layout, but its plan treated the packaged Python executable as the source of runtime jsonschema behavior despite the pure-JavaScript and black-box reimplementation requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned final implementation and verification, while children were assigned or drifted into CLI and behavior probing. There was no missing final owner; the parent assembled and delivered the files.
parallel.implementation: The parent implemented constants, CLI parsing, runner, main, index, and test20.mjs. The key behavior was a node:child_process bridge that invokes /workspace/dataset/test20_executable rather than a local JSON Schema implementation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent created the final entrypoint and module list under /output and delivered it. Child work was largely exploratory; one nested probe result supported executable forwarding and two helpers were interrupted around completion.
parallel.verification: Verification compared the wrapper against the same executable for selected success, help, missing-argument, equals-syntax, negative-number, and invalid-JSON cases; this validated the wrapper behavior, not pure-JS compliance.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The delivered artifact violated the visible pure-JS reimplementation obligation by relying on the Python executable at runtime, and the completed official evaluator later scored it 0 of 58.

serial.requirements: Serial recognized the same ESM, manual CLI, local-import, no-external-dependency, and behavioral parity requirements and treated the task as a pure-JS reimplementation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single serial agent owned probing, implementation, integration, and verification end to end, without delegation or subagent handoffs.
serial.implementation: Serial built a multi-module local JSON Schema subset: custom JSON number/parser handling, draft selection, schema checking, validator engine, error tree, Python-style printing, CLI parsing, and entrypoint.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial assembled the modules into /output/test20.mjs and lib/*.mjs, then listed the final file set as a local ESM port with only local imports.
serial.verification: Serial ran many direct executable probes, targeted differential checks, fixed one dependency-keyword mismatch, and completed a broader randomized differential run over the implemented subset with zero observed failures.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite broader pure-JS work, the implementation was still only a subset of jsonschema behavior and failed the official 58-sample evaluator completely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel acknowledged exact CLI and output behavior but violated the pure-JS reimplementation obligation by planning and delivering executable forwarding.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial treated the same prompt as requiring a local ESM reimplementation and explicitly described a pure Node port with custom parsing and validation modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel prioritized byte-for-byte executable behavior through a runtime bridge; serial prioritized implementing the library behavior in JavaScript, though neither passed official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split probing across several children while the parent retained final implementation and delivery ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single end-to-end owner for probing, implementation, integration, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel distributed investigation but not final ownership; serial kept ownership unified and therefore avoided handoff complexity.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children received the original prompt context in their sessions and returned or developed executable-probing findings; no incompatible module interface contract between completed child components was adopted.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained all task knowledge in one thread and iterated directly on module interfaces inside its own implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The important context difference was not a missing child brief but the parallel parent accepting an executable-bridge strategy despite the visible pure-JS requirement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a small wrapper stack and runner.mjs, with runtime behavior supplied by spawning the Python executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a substantial local implementation: JSON number and parser modules, validator engine, schema checks, draft metadata, tree, CLI, and entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel avoided reimplementing jsonschema; serial attempted reimplementation and corrected at least one observed mismatch.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: A nested behavior probe completed with findings, while cli_probe and behavior_probe were interrupted or left unfinished after the parent had enough local confidence to close.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; all probes, fixes, and finalization occurred in one trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had auxiliary child lifecycle noise, but the completed child finding reinforced the executable-forwarding path rather than providing a correct implementation to join.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent wrote the final files under /output, and helper children only created additional directories or probe state; no proven same-file overwrite or adopted incompatible child implementation appears.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and integrated all modules in one apply_patch operation, then listed the resulting final tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared workspace activity from children, but the final artifact provenance remains primarily the parent wrapper; serial integration was single-owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified wrapper parity against the executable on selected cases and then accepted the whole task as complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran targeted comparisons, fixed a detected mismatch, ran a broader randomized differential set, and then accepted the local subset implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel tests validated the prohibited bridge; serial tests validated a local implementation subset but did not cover enough behavior to pass official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel finished quickly, 310.14 agent seconds with four subagents and no timeout, while some auxiliary child work was interrupted near closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 898.849 agent seconds, no subagents, and no timeout, spending the extra time on implementation and differential checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed sooner by choosing a runtime bridge; serial spent more budget building code. Neither failed because of host timeout or exhausted budget.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail: each completed evaluation reports solution_passed false with 0 of 58 samples passed. The process difference is still concrete: parallel delivered an executable bridge after parallel probing, while serial delivered a larger local ESM validator subset. Because both failed, the retained parallel pattern is an adverse parallel process issue rather than an explanation for a pass/fail discordance.
parallel_contributors: Parallel accepted an executable-backed wrapper despite the visible pure-JS reimplementation requirement.
Parallel verification compared the wrapper against the executable, so it did not test the required independent implementation.
serial_contributors: Serial attempted a pure local implementation with custom JSON parsing and draft-specific validation.
Serial verification covered targeted and randomized subset cases but still did not satisfy the full official evaluator.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel's primary defect was strategy-level noncompliance with the prompt, while serial's was incomplete jsonschema feature coverage.
The different artifacts explain different failure modes even though the official aggregate score was identical.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative contributors only
